plans.idea: Classic leaderboard read left to right: brand sign-on, then the phone with its NEW FLAVOR sticker beside it, then a wide two-line text block (headline over subhead), ending on a generous dark CTA pill at the right edge.

Product-first opener: the phone and its sticker anchor the left edge as the visual hook, the headline/subhead carry the middle, the CTA follows the copy, and the logo signs off at the far right like a brand end-card.
Message-led: logo then the headline block open the strip, and the product with its NEW FLAVOR sticker sits right next to the CTA on the right so the eye moves message, then product, then action.
